# Shreyash Tripathi

> Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Engineer based in Noida, India. Builds production UI with React, Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript, and contributes to AI-integrated SaaS platforms and marketing sites at a digital product agency. Available for full-time roles (full-stack, frontend or backend) and freelance full-stack projects (https://shreyashtripathi.in/hire).

Name also searched as: Shreyas Tripathi.

## Summary

Author of the Job-Ready Series (11 interview-prep and job-switch books for developers, about 4,200 pages): https://shreyashtripathi.in/books

Shreyash Tripathi is a full-stack developer and UI/UX engineer with production experience shipping features on AI-integrated SaaS platforms and marketing sites at a digital product agency. He builds UI across React, Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript codebases using Tailwind CSS, Supabase and REST APIs, and is comfortable owning components end-to-end — from responsive layout and design-system consistency through backend integration. He is currently a Junior Developer, UI/UX at Garage Collective, promoted from an AI Trainee role.

## Skills

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C++, Python, SQL
- Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router), Vite, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, Responsive Design
- Animation & Motion: Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Lenis, Lottie
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express.js, Hono, REST API design
- Databases & Auth: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, RLS), MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Clerk
- AI Integration: OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude SDK, AI content & automation pipelines
- Tools & Deployment: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Turborepo, Stripe, Razorpay, Postman, VS Code

## Experience

- Junior Developer, UI/UX — Garage Collective, Noida (Feb 2026 – present), promoted from AI Trainee. Ships production UI and AI-powered features across the agency's client and SaaS portfolio: analytics dashboard integrations, a 45-page school marketing site rebuild, an internal zero-knowledge asset, credential and billing manager he built end to end (QR asset labels, invoice OCR, multi-currency spend), a daily AI content-generation agent (~40% less manual effort), UTM auto-tagging and partner-portal tooling for a multi-tenant affiliate-marketing SaaS platform, UI theming and responsiveness work on an AI call-screening product's marketing site, dark-mode fixes on a social-listening platform, and UI/build fixes on a startup-investor marketplace and an SEO/AI-visibility platform. Broader stack exposure spans Three.js, GSAP, Framer Motion, Stripe/Razorpay, Clerk and Turborepo.

## Projects

- PurrCase — custom phone-case store with a photo-based case designer, Stripe checkout and order emails (Next.js 14, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kinde Auth, Stripe); team project, Shreyash built the frontend (https://purr-case.vercel.app).
- SketchRace — real-time multiplayer drawing & guessing game (Socket.IO, Node.js, Canvas API, Next.js 15, React 19); team project, Shreyash built the Socket.IO backend (https://sketchrace.vercel.app).
- Asset & Credential Vault — internal zero-knowledge asset, credential and billing manager built solo (Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, WebCrypto): QR asset labels, who-has-what allocation, invoice OCR, multi-currency spend, one-time share links; PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM in the browser (https://shreyashtripathi.in/projects/asset-credential-vault).
- Job Portal — full-stack job portal built solo with Next.js 15, TypeScript, REST API routes, JWT + bcrypt auth and a PostgreSQL schema: job search, saved jobs, applications and a user dashboard (https://v0-mern-job-portal-one.vercel.app).
- Portfolio Website — this interactive, SEO-optimized cyberpunk-themed personal site (https://shreyashtripathi.in).

## Books (Job-Ready Series)

Shreyash wrote a series of interview and job-preparation books for developers, all in simple language with worked examples and interview questions with answers. Free previews on each page; full books free on request by email.

- [All books](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books)
- [System Design: From Zero to Hero](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/system-design): Complete 796 pages, Short 283 pages. 28 chapters in 5 parts; 25+ real system case studies; Question bank with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [DSA in Java: From Zero to Offer](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/dsa-java): Java edition 405 pages. Java basics included; 20 problem-solving patterns; Brute force to optimal, with dry runs. Free preview PDF.
- [DSA in Python: From Zero to Offer](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/dsa-python): Python edition 406 pages. Python basics included; 20 problem-solving patterns; Brute force to optimal, with dry runs. Free preview PDF.
- [DSA in C++: From Zero to Offer](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/dsa-cpp): Short edition 256 pages. C++ and STL basics included; 20 problem-solving patterns; 100 must-do problems, with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [DevOps: The Job-Switch Guide](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/devops): Job-Switch edition 364 pages. 13 tools from Linux to Kubernetes (Docker, CI/CD, AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana); hands-on labs, real configs and production incidents; 120+ interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [Cloud Computing: The Job-Switch Guide](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/cloud): Job-Switch edition 345 pages. AWS-first with Azure and GCP: IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, security, cost and architecture; free-tier labs and projects; 120+ interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [Salesforce: The Job-Switch Guide](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/salesforce): Job-Switch edition 360 pages. From Admin to Developer: data model, security, Flow, reports, Apex, SOQL, triggers, governor limits, LWC, integration and DevOps; org labs and projects; 120+ interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [Database Management Systems](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/dbms): Complete 422 pages, Short 186 pages. ER models to B+ trees; SQL from basics to window functions; 120+ interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [Computer Networks](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/computer-networks): Complete 364 pages, Short 164 pages. OSI and TCP/IP to TLS; Worked subnetting numericals; 100+ interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [Operating Systems](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/operating-systems): Short 192 pages. Processes to containers and Linux; Worked scheduling and paging numericals; 90+ interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
- [Full-Stack TypeScript and Next.js](https://shreyashtripathi.in/books/fullstack-typescript-nextjs): Compact 362 pages. TypeScript, React and Next.js; Node.js APIs, databases, auth and Docker; 100 interview questions with answers. Free preview PDF.
